d: Abhishek Banerjee opens up about his journey as an actor, the craft behind some of his most memorable performances, and the choices that have shaped his career in this episode of Select Conversations with Tisca Chopra, by Royal Stag Barrel Select Shorts. In conversation with actor and host Tisca, Abhishek talks about acting, storytelling, finding the right characters, and what it takes to create work that truly stands out.
